description: A maintenance block must not overlap with scheduled train movement on the affected section
A maintenance task must fit continuously inside the selected block window
Maintenance must be scheduled only on a block window belonging to the same section as the affected asset
A required maintenance resource must be available for the assigned task during its scheduled period
Only tasks explicitly compatible may be combined into an integrated maintenance block
High-criticality safety work should receive priority when competing for the same feasible maintenance opportunity
The optimizer should prefer scheduling within the task requested time range when feasible
The optimizer should minimize total infrastructure blockage and unnecessary corridor downtime
The optimizer should prefer safely combining compatible maintenance activities into a shared block
If no feasible block exists the task may remain unscheduled with an explicit reason
